sharded_evaluation.reason: Equivalent non-overlapping level-offset/max-levels shards for wall-clock acceleration.
sharded_evaluation.seed_equivalence_rule: shard_seed = level_offset * 1009 so local rng seed + local_level_index*1009 equals full-run seed + global_level_index*1009 with full-run seed 0.

two_layer_state.ledger_state_y: y_t=(B_t,R_t), exact box positions plus player reachable component

resource_stocks.P: goal-conditioned transport progress / remaining transport work
resource_stocks.D: hard deadlock debt plus soft deadlock pressure
resource_stocks.C: goal commitment clarity from Sinkhorn assignment entropy
resource_stocks.I: action relevance for the soft MCTS prior

learnable_parameters.tva_layer: external; consumes ledger and GFT feature vectors when trained
